issues.rootCause: Migrations 033, 034, 035 were present in supabase/migrations but missing from MIGRATION_MANIFEST in MigrationRunner.ts and packages/database/src/index.ts. Provisioned databases did not run central policies, tenant reconciliation status hardening, or customer status lifecycle hardening.
issues.proposedFix: Add 033, 034, 035 to MIGRATION_MANIFEST in MigrationRunner.ts and packages/database/src/index.ts, and apply additive migrations to active database instances.
issues.verification: npm run db:test (22/22 passed), node --test services/backend/tests/roadmap-phase-09-financial-calculation-settlement.test.js (38/38 passed)

issues.rootCause: Migration file supabase/migrations/031_remove_dairy_admin_7507495615.sql contained hardcoded specific phone numbers and operational data modifications inside the primary migration tracking directory.
issues.proposedFix: Relocate maintenance data script to scripts/maintenance/031_remove_dairy_admin_7507495615.sql and remove 031_quarantined entry from MIGRATION_MANIFEST.
issues.verification: Migration static analysis confirms 0 non-declarative operational scripts in active migration manifests. npm run db:test passes.

issues.rootCause: In apps/dfarm-super-admin/src/api/client.ts and activationFlow.test.ts, fetch requests leaked to background server on port 4000, creating split-brain state where validateActivationToken hit port 4000 while activatePrimaryAdmin updated mockBackend.
issues.proposedFix: In activationFlow.test.ts, stub fetch to isolate unit test execution. In client.ts, ensure error responses do not silently mask failure states.
issues.verification: npm run test --workspace=apps/dfarm-super-admin passes all 7 test suites (34/34 tests passed).

issues.rootCause: Canonical YuNet+SFace 128D cosine distance threshold is set to 0.720 in FaceModelService.ts, but empirical false acceptance vs false rejection benchmarks in real ambient rural lighting conditions require calibrated field datasets.
issues.proposedFix: Quarantine threshold tuning as requiring field calibration dataset. Documented exact threshold and model configuration in FaceModelService.ts without arbitrary modifications.
issues.verification: Face verification tests pass in backend and collection app (8/8 in dairy-face-matcher.test.ts). Documented for hardware field rollout.

issues.rootCause: In HardwareContext.tsx, defaultMeasurements initialized state with synthetic test readings (fat: 4.2, snf: 8.7, weight: 12.5, scaleConnected: true, readingsValid: true), enabling intake submission without live hardware telemetry.
issues.proposedFix: Reset defaultMeasurements to zero/null state: fat: 0, snf: 0, clrDensity: 0, weightLiters: 0, analyzerConnected: false, scaleConnected: false, readingsValid: false, with validation errors requiring active hardware connection.
issues.verification: npm run test --workspace=apps/dfarm-collection-app passes all 8 test suites (40/40 tests passed).

issues.rootCause: Domain module routers (/billing, /rates, /reconciliation, /identification, /inventory, /employees, /attendance, /payroll, /webhooks/whatsapp) were mounted redundantly in both presentation/routes/index.ts and app.ts, causing route collision and divergent middleware behavior.
issues.proposedFix: Consolidate all domain module routes inside cleanApiRouter in presentation/routes/index.ts and remove duplicate mounts from app.ts. Add /accounts/:customerId route to presentation/routes/ledger.routes.ts.
issues.verification: npm run test --workspace=services/backend passes clean-architecture.test.js (9/9 passed) and financial calculation test suite (38/38 passed).

issues.rootCause: Client request interceptors attached duplicate headers (X-Dairy-Tenant-ID, x-dairy-id, and X-Dairy-Id) simultaneously on outgoing HTTP requests, causing redundant header processing.
issues.proposedFix: Standardized on authoritative canonical header X-Dairy-Id and removed duplicate header mutations.
issues.verification: Dairy Admin and Collection App test suites pass with 100% success (14/14 and 40/40).

issues.rootCause: useCollection.ts and useLedger.ts query hooks executed requests to /collection/history and /ledger/entries without default pagination parameters, risking large payload transfer on farmer accounts with long delivery histories.
issues.proposedFix: Added default pagination parameters { page: 1, pageSize: 30 } in useCollection.ts and useLedger.ts.
issues.verification: npm run test --workspace=apps/dfarm-customer-app passes all 5 test suites (20/20 tests passed).

issues.rootCause: Late offline collections arriving after session close were marked RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and credited to farmer subledger with audit note, but transaction status required verification against billing exclusions and duplicate credits.
issues.proposedFix: Additive migration 034 hardens transaction_status to support RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED across all tenant databases. Confirmed billing service queries exclusively transaction_status = 'COMPLETED', blocking late offline collections from bills until supervisor approves.
issues.verification: Financial settlement tests confirm RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED transactions are quarantined from bill calculation. sync.service safeSavepoints hardened.

issues.rootCause: mock-server.ts and mock-backend.ts were positioned inside src/api/ production directory trees, risking dead-code inclusion in production web assets.
issues.proposedFix: Relocated mock-server.ts to apps/dfarm-dairy-admin/src/test/mocks/mock-server.ts and mock-backend.ts to apps/dfarm-collection-app/src/test/mocks/mock-backend.ts. Updated test imports.
issues.verification: Full production builds (npm run build) across all workspaces succeed cleanly without mock imports in production code.
